explication: Primuse is a native Apple-ecosystem music player that unifies local and remote music sources in a shared library and playback queue. Its principal workflow is to connect or import a source, browse or search its catalog, resolve a playable item, and play it with format-aware decoding and system controls. The product also includes radio, recommendations, lyrics and metadata tooling, synchronization, and companion experiences across Apple platforms. Several important modules are named in the source index but were not excerpted; their internals and call relationships are therefore not inferred here.
